newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's Lee has inflammation taken from bladder.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's Lee has inflammation taken from bladder.

text.p: Singapore Senior Minister Lee Kwan Yew had a small area of chronic inflammation removed from his bladder over the weekend, the Singapore government said.
A government statement issued late on Monday said doctors assessed Lee's bladder function on Friday and examined it on Saturday.
"A small area of chronic inflammation was removed from the bladder," the statement said.
It said Lee, who was the city-state's first prime minister, was discharged on Sunday and had been told to rest this week. He should then be able to resume normal activities.
An earlier government statement had said Lee, 73, had had chronic inflammatory tissue removed from the wall of his bladder on two previous occasions.
